custom_logic_notes: Triangular arbitrage across EURUSD, GBPUSD, EURGBP. When EURUSDask/GBPUSDbid > EURGBPask + threshold (commission+spread cost), opens: Sell EURUSD, Buy GBPUSD, Buy EURGBP (3-leg hedge). When EURUSDbid/GBPUSDask < EURGBPbid - threshold, opens: Buy EURUSD, Sell GBPUSD, Sell EURGBP. Opposite-side positions are closed before new leg entry. All 3 legs use same volume. Volume capped by EURGBP max volume. Has a typo: 'GPBUSD' instead of 'GBPUSD' in CheckVolumeValue calls on lines 51 and 67.
python_conversion_notes: Requires tick-level multi-symbol data for EURUSD, GBPUSD, EURGBP simultaneously. Entry signals are tick-level price ratio comparisons. Commission and spread costs are dynamically incorporated into the threshold. The three-leg simultaneous execution is critical - slippage on any leg invalidates the arbitrage. A Python implementation would need high-frequency tick data and realistic multi-symbol fill modeling. The 'GPBUSD' typo in CheckVolumeValue calls means volume validation for GBPUSD is silently skipped in the original code. Signal reversal closes opposite-side legs before entering new arbitrage positions.
